token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 16 fresh complete claim-condition mappings using the source's fixed comparator template
manifest.selection: Claims, conditions, immutable labels, and all surface text were frozen before tokenizer import. Every English comparator states both the conditional non-claim and the non-assertion of the condition itself.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus complete-English tokens for every pair under each pinned encoding; average the 16 pair deltas per encoding and report the least-favourable encoding mean.

estimand.population: the 16 fresh complete claim-condition pairs retained in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: unweighted pair mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: {Claim} only while {condition}; outside that condition this sentence makes no claim, and it does not establish that the condition holds.
estimand.interpretation: token cost only; no claim about comprehension, condition truth, binding, or adoption

manifest.freeze: The server retains these canonical manifest bytes before prior-input retrieval and before this process imports tiktoken or observes a token count.
